ZAMEEN LUXE (SMC-PRIVATE) LIMITED
NOTES TO THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS
FOR THE YEAR ENDED 30 JUNE 2023
1

COMPANY AND ITS OPERATIONS

1.1

Corporate and General Information
Zameen Luxe (SMC-Private) Limited ("the Company") was incorporated on 29 April 2021 as a Single
member Company under the Companies Act (The Act). The Company's principal activity is to engage in
the business of development of all types of real estate including commercial markets and multi-storey
buildings, shopping centers etc. The registered office of the Company is situated at Pearl One, 94-B/I,
M.M. Alam Road Gulberg III, Lahore. The Company is a subsidiary of Zameen Venture One (Private)
Limited ("the Parent Company"), a Company incorporated in Pakistan. The ultimate parent of the
Company is Dubizzle Group Holdings Limited (formerly known as EMPG Holdings Limited), a company
incorporated in United Arab Emirates (UAE).

The Company is in startup phase, and it is yet to start construction in the project. The Company has
incurred loss of Rs. 375,388 (2022: Rs. 167,409) and its accumulated losses as at the reporting date
amounts to Rs. 542,797 (2022: Rs.167,409) resulting in a negative equity of Rs. 541,797 (2022: Rs.
166,409) as at that date. The Parent Company has committed to provide financial support to the
Company, enabling the Company to continue its operations as going concern and fulfil all of its financial
obligation, based on which the financial statements of the Company are prepared on going concern basis.
2

BASIS OF PREPARATION

2.1

Statement of compliance
These financial statements have been prepared in accordance with the accounting and reporting
standards as applicable in Pakistan. The accounting and reporting standards applicable in Pakistan
comprise of:
- International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS Standards) issued by the International Accounting
Standards Board (IASB) as notified under the Companies Act, 2017; and
- Provisions of and directives issued under the Companies Act, 2017.
Where provisions of and directives issued under the Companies Act, 2017 differ from the IFRS standards,
the provisions of and directives of the Companies Act, 2017 have been followed.

2.2

Basis of measurement
These financial statements have been prepared under the historical cost convention unless otherwise
stated. In these financial statements, except for the amounts reflected in the statement of cash flows, all
transactions have been accounted for on accrual basis.

2.3

Functional and presentation currency
These financial statements are presented in Pak Rupees, which is the Company’s functional currency. All
figures have been rounded off to the nearest Rupee, unless otherwise stated.

2.4

Standards, interpretations and amendments to published accounting standards
The following are new and amended standards and interpretations effective for annual period beginning
on July 01, 2022, as listed below:

2.4.1 New Standards, Interpretations and Amendments effective in the reporting period
The accounting policies adopted in the preparation of these financial statements are consistent with those
of the previous financial year, except for following amendments to accounting standards which are
effective for annual periods beginning on or after July 01, 2022 (unless otherwise stated).
IFRS 3

Business Combinations – The amendment updates a reference in IFRS 3 to the Conceptual
Framework for Financial Reporting without changing the accounting requirements for business
combinations.
